{{Quote|I am Warden Gorshaa. We are the last of the true masters, the Rakata. We watch over this place, guarding it from intruding slaves.|Gorshaa to Kallig|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Gorshaa''' was a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Warden/Legends|Warden]] who resided on the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire's]] prison world of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. He lived by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] where he along with like-minded Rakata claimed to be the last of the true masters who watched over [[the Tomb]] and guarded it from intruding slaves. Warden Gorshaa and his kin were not concerned with guarding the prisoners or the conflict that emerged their world but rather their experiments involving [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]]. This was in order to restore their own lost [[The Force/Legends|Force]] connection by testing the lesser species and using the powerful [[Mother Machine]] to accomplish this goal.

Upon witnessing the arrival of the Sith Lord [[Darth Nox|Kallig]], he warned the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to return back. After Kallig succeeded in entering into the superhub chamber, Gorshaa revealed his presence and remarked at how he was impressed with the Sith's capabilities. He further commented that this perhaps marked for some hope for the [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] races. The Warden offered the Sith a chance to control the spiraling Force energies in Kallig's body in exchange for an imprint of their pattern for their own research.

Interestingly, despite his relative seclusion from other Belsavis residents, Gorshaa knew [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] and was able to use the mail. After the Sith gave his pattern to Mother Machine, Gorshaa sent him a thankful letter with some [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]].
